anomalies.observed: The STM32 MCU U3 has its pin 1 (VBAT) on an unconnected net with a no-connect flag; it is not connected to VCC or any backup supply.
anomalies.expected: Because the design has no battery or separate backup supply, the STM32 VBAT pin should be tied to VCC per standard ST practice, rather than left floating.

evidence.quote: no battery, regulator, or USB part appears anywhere

anomalies.impact: The MCU backup domain (RTC, backup registers, LSE) is left unpowered and the VBAT pin floats. This can cause unreliable backup-domain operation or increased leakage, even though the primary VDD-powered functions may still run.

parsed.summary: The netlist leaves the STM32 VBAT pin unconnected instead of tying it to VCC in a no-battery design; the rest of the NFC, display, touch and SWD connectivity matches the specification.
